properties.description: Maxwell House is a historic American coffee brand widely recognized for its long-standing presence in households and its iconic slogan, 'Good to the last drop.' Owned by Kraft Heinz, the brand offers a wide range of coffee products including ground coffee, instant blends, and single-serve pods designed for convenience and consistency.
